title: Brandy Heading to Africa to Headline Flytime’s House of R&B Concert for Lagos’ Detty December
summary: The Vocal Bible is headed to Africa.
contentText:
Brandy is set to headline Flytime’s House of R&B concert in Lagos, Nigeria. The anticipated show will be one of the main events taking over Detty December on Dec. 20.

Taking place at the Eko Convention Centre, the House of R&B concert is slated to kick off a series of performances, which will be followed by Coca-Cola Rhythm Unplugged (Dec. 21), Flytime Fest Powered by Coca-Cola (Dec. 22-24) and Flytime Circle on Dec. 25.

“Brandy is one of the most influential voices in R&B, and bringing her to the Flytime stage is incredibly special,” said Cecil Hammond, who serves as the founder and chief executive officer of Flytime, in a statement. “We’ve watched Lagos grow into a global destination for music and entertainment over the past two decades, and we’re proud to have played a part in that journey. Brandy represents everything Flytime’s House of R&B celebrates, and she is the perfect artist to open our December season.”

Flytime chief operating officer Keke Hammond added: “Every year, we challenge ourselves to raise the standard of live entertainment in Lagos. This December brings six nights, each with its own identity and experience. Opening with an artist of Brandy’s caliber sets the tone for the performances and hospitality our guests can expect all season.”

Ahead of Flytime’s House of R&B, Brandy has three shows lined up in South Africa. She’ll head to Cape Town for a concert on Dec. 14 before trekking to Pretoria for concerts on Dec. 17 and Dec. 18.

2026 has been a busy year for The Vocal Bible. Brandy notched collabs with Ty Dolla $ign , Kehlani and Josh Levi, and was honored with a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame. The Grammy-winning singer also released her New York Times bestselling memoir PHASES .
